verdict.rationale: Algolia documents its own Crawler, which turns web pages into records, and first-party integrations for Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce and Zendesk. Algolia also manages schedules, retries and transformations from the dashboard without code, so a founder can skip building an indexing pipeline. Community users praise DocSearch's low-maintenance setup, but one reports that the crawler times out on slow-loading pages and misses content. Missing for 10: connectors beyond the listed commerce/helpdesk platforms (e.g. databases or CMSs) are not evidenced, and the crawler can miss content on slow-loading pages.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline

citations.quote: The Crawler extracts content from your pages and turns it into records.
If your data is in one of these platforms, use an integration: Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce, or Zendesk.
Algolia keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations. Configure them in the Algolia dashboard without deploying code.
